appraisal_events.evidence: M. Legrandin avait à peine répondu, d'un air étonné, comme s'il ne nous reconnaissait pas... un signe de tête minuscule pour le proportionner à vos dimensions de marionnette.
appraisal_events.explanation: Legrandin's exaggeratedly distant, minimal greeting appears to snub the father in front of a titled lady, though the family's own charitable interpretation leaves the intent genuinely uncertain within the passage.

appraisal_events.evidence: cette perspective du regard particulière aux personnes qui ne veulent pas être aimables et qui... ont l'air de vous apercevoir comme au bout d'une route interminable
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's mockingly detailed description of Legrandin's theatrical aloofness exposes him as affectedly self-important and status-conscious, undercutting him even as the family debates whether he meant offense.

status_effects.explanation: The father is momentarily dismissed and left puzzled by Legrandin's cold, barely-acknowledging greeting in front of the châtelaine.
The ironic narration of his contrived, distant manner locally lowers Legrandin even though the family does not openly condemn him.

ambiguities: The passage frames Legrandin's coldness with narratorial irony suggesting a real snub, but the family explicitly concludes it was misperceived and Legrandin's warm greeting the next day dissipates the father's worry, leaving the reality and intent of the snub genuinely uncertain within this text.
